import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_99/training_0.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = ['user_id', 'timestamp', 'source', 'device', 'operative_system', 'test', 'price', 'converted']
    # user_id, test, price, converted are integers; timestamp, source, device, operative_system are strings

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema
        # Source schema matches target schema exactly, so no renaming needed
        # Enforce column order to match target schema
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Enforce data types explicitly
        df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].astype(int)
        df['timestamp'] = df['timestamp'].astype(str)
        df['source'] = df['source'].astype(str)
        df['device'] = df['device'].astype(str)
        df['operative_system'] = df['operative_system'].astype(str)
        df['test'] = df['test'].astype(int)
        df['price'] = df['price'].astype(int)
        df['converted'] = df['converted'].astype(int)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the same schema as target, union (concat) them
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_99/target_multisource.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
